package.description: 纳米Work AI 工作平台，全天候自动化执行你的工作任务。

en-US.description: NamiWork AI work platform that runs your tasks around the clock.
en-US.longDescription: NamiWork is a 360 AI work platform for the desktop. It provides a team of AI experts on a multi-agent engine, runs scheduled cloud tasks around the clock, connects to your work systems, and organizes project spaces and a three-level knowledge base, protected by 360 security with permissions, confirmations, and audit logs.

zh-CN.longDescription: 纳米Work 是 360 推出的 AI 工作平台桌面客户端，提供 AI 专家团队与多智能体引擎，支持云端全天候自动化任务、工作系统连接、项目空间与三级知识库共享，并以 360 安全体系保障权限确认、文件保护与审计日志。
